**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 16:21  
[USER] The user is trying to reduce their screen time.  
[USER] The user read an article in The New Yorker about the impact of social media on mental health today.  
[CHANGE] The user is looking for ways to cut back on their social media use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on taking the first step towards reducing screen time and taking control of social media usage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that excessive social media use has been linked to negative effects on mental health, including increased anxiety, depression, and loneliness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a list of phone apps to help track and limit social media use:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Freedom: Blocks distracting websites and apps across all devices, allows custom block sessions, schedules blocks in advance, and tracks productivity.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Moment: Tracks screen time, provides detailed reports on habits, offers app blocking, goal-setting, and coaching.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. StayFocused: Blocks social media sites and other distracting websites during certain times or for a set period.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. RescueTime: Tracks time spent on the phone, including social media, and provides insights into productivity.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Screen Time: A built-in feature on iOS devices that tracks screen time, sets app limits, and provides insights.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Cold Turkey: Blocks distracting websites and apps during set periods.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Flipd: Blocks social media and tracks productivity with motivational reminders.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. SelfControl: Blocks distracting websites and emails for a set period on Mac and Linux.  
[USER] The user is interested in trying out Freedom and Moment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided detailed information about how Freedom works, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Blocking websites and apps, custom blocks, scheduling blocks, Locked mode, syncing across devices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Freedom tracks time spent on blocked sites and apps, block sessions, and goals/achievements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided detailed information about how Moment works, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Screen time tracking, app tracking, goal-setting, phone-free modes, and screen-free days.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Moment tracks screen time, app usage, and goal progress.
